mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mingle_support_tickets ( id, user_id, category, title, content ) VALUES ( seq_mingle_support_tickets.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, category, title, content, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM mingle_support_tickets WHERE user_id = 1 ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE mingle_support_tickets SET status = 'RESOLVED', updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id}
